asciichat_error_t zalgo_apply (const char * input, size_t length, int level, size_t max_output_bytes, char ** output)

Decorate a frame within the caller's byte budget; errors leave no partially decorated output.

Decorate an ANSI frame with deterministic combining marks. Caller frees *output. REP is expanded before decoration. Only printable ASCII bases are decorated; whitespace, existing UTF-8, and escape sequences are preserved. The byte limit excludes the NUL terminator; on overflow returns an error with *output = NULL.
